senses.definition: An ongoing winner in a game or contest.
examples: The defending champion is expected to defeat his challenger.

quotes.text: Curry, a four-time NBA champion with the Warriors, played for the Wildcats for three seasons between 2006 and 2009, where he was twice named conference player of the year.

senses.definition: Someone who is chosen to represent a group of people in a contest.
examples: Barcelona is eligible to play in FIFA Club World Cup as the champion of Europe.

senses.definition: Someone who fights for a cause or status.
examples: Emmeline Pankhurst was a champion of women's suffrage.

senses.definition: Someone who fights on another's behalf.

(transitive) To promote, advocate, or act as a champion for (a cause, etc.).
